_note: Church directory (/churches/). Hand-kept. Every fact comes from the church's own website (or its denomination's official locator page) and carries a verified date; service times exactly as published. Name churches only, never clergy, staff or members. Ministries listed only when the church publishes them as open to the community. Checked monthly for dead links and entries older than 90 days by scripts/check-resources.mjs.

items.name: CrossView Christian Church
items.services: Sundays at 9:00 and 10:45 a.m. The 9:00 service is livestreamed on Facebook.
ministries: Called 2 Care: free donated children's clothing, high chairs, strollers, shoes and more for foster, adoptive and kinship families. Open Wednesdays 6–7:30 p.m.; enter at the back of the building off Lytle Ferry Road.
Food 2 Go: meals for elementary-age children in the Waynesville community.
Collects food donations for the Waynesville Food Pantry.
CrossView Cares: request help such as meals, home or car repairs, help for seniors and people with disabilities, visits, or prayer, through the church's website.
Student ministry for middle and high school: small groups on Wednesdays.

items.name: Harvest Baptist Church
items.services: Sundays at 10 a.m. and 6 p.m.; Wednesday studies at 6:30 p.m.
ministries: Children's church (pre-K through 6th grade) during the 10 a.m. service.
HisPins youth archery on Wednesday evenings (dates on the church calendar).
Harvest Family Fun Day, a free community event each October.
Fifth Sunday fellowship meal after the morning service; guests welcome.

items.name: Miami Monthly Meeting (Religious Society of Friends)
items.tradition: Friends (Quaker), unprogrammed worship · Ohio Valley Yearly Meeting
items.address: White Brick Meetinghouse, 169 S. Fourth St., Waynesville
items.services: Meeting for worship Sundays at 10:45 a.m., in person and online.
ministries: First Day School (religious education) Sundays at 9:30 a.m.
Carry-in lunch the first Sunday of each month; all welcome.

items.name: St. Augustine Catholic Church
items.tradition: Roman Catholic · Holy Saints of God Family of Parishes, Archdiocese of Cincinnati

items.name: St. Mary's Episcopal Church
ministries: Home of the Waynesville Food Pantry and Wayne Township Community Aid: non-perishable food, some paper, personal and household items, and help with utility bills, for Waynesville, Wayne Township, Corwin, Harveysburg, Lytle and Oregonia. Call 283-221-6908.
Bible study on the 2nd and 4th Sundays at 9:30 a.m.

items.name: Wellspring Baptist Church
items.services: Sundays: fellowship 9:45 a.m., worship 10 a.m., evening service 6 p.m. Wednesdays: Bible study and prayer, 7 p.m.
ministries: F.L.A.S.H. Kids Club (ages 4–12), Wednesdays 7–8 p.m. during the school year.
Nursery during all services; Sunday school for ages 3–12 during the morning service.
